name: Marcus — Motorsport Enthusiast / AFOL
description: Software engineer who watches F1 every weekend and follows supercar channels on YouTube. Owns 4 Technic sets, displays them on a dedicated shelf. LEGO Insiders member with 3,200 points. Wants the most complex, authentic builds with real engineering detail.
goals: Find the next impressive display piece
Stay up to date on new Technic supercar releases
painPoints: Hard to choose next build among many options
Wants engineering detail and authentic features
Doesn't want to miss limited editions or new drops

entryPoints: Direct PDP links from YouTube reviews

name: Priya — Gift Buyer
description: Product designer buying for partner who loves cars and LEGO. Needs gift guidance — price ranges, difficulty levels, what's new and exclusive. Looking for something impressive that says 'I thought about this.'
goals: Find a meaningful gift in the $100-$300 range
Understand what makes a set special or exclusive
Get the gift delivered on time
painPoints: Unsure which sets are too advanced or too simple

entryPoints: Google search 'best LEGO sets for adults'

name: Jake — Returning Builder
description: Played with LEGO as a kid, rediscovering the hobby as an adult. Wants a curated entry point — something iconic and rewarding but not overwhelming. Looking for that sweet spot between challenge and accessibility.
goals: Find an iconic set that feels worth the investment
painPoints: Overwhelmed by the sheer number of products
Doesn't know where to start with adult sets
Price sensitivity — wants to feel value before going premium

name: Tyler — Movie Fan & Pop Culture Collector
description: Film buff and pop culture collector who buys LEGO sets tied to franchises he loves. Grew up watching Fast and Furious, now wants the cars on his shelf. Cross-shops with other movie merchandise and gaming collectibles. Responds strongly to 'NEW' badges and franchise tie-ins.
goals: Collect every Fast and Furious LEGO set
Display movie cars alongside other franchise collectibles
Stay on top of new franchise releases before they sell out
painPoints: Worried about sets retiring before he can buy them
Wants to know which sets pair together for a collection
Budget-conscious — prioritizes franchise connection over complexity

browsingBehavior.frequency: Around movie releases and new set drops
